MNSIM vendor adapter
====================

Upstream: https://github.com/thu-nics/MNSIM-2.0 (Python PIM modelling tool, not a pip/REST API).

This folder is our backend adapter of MNSIM's crossbar PIM cost model (array MAC + DAC/ADC)
mapped onto the project's tabular IDS MLP. Classification still uses sklearn on CICIDS/UNSW-NB15.
